claims.claim: Includes a 'center table' as well as the TV console
claims.evidence: Witness report only describes the TV stand/wall unit in photo 0; no center table is mentioned or shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No shot of internal joints, cupboard interiors, or back panel to confirm no prior repair.
This claim describes an electronic device, not a wooden TV stand; the report shows no device with ports being tested, screen is off.

claims.claim: Comes with original pads and UK receipt
claims.evidence: No photo of pads or receipt in the witness report; 'pads' is not a feature typical of a TV stand.

risks.risk: Mismatched description: seller's claims (ports, overheating, pads) describe an electronic item, not the wooden TV stand the witness saw.
risks.proof: A photo clearly matching the seller's described item (e.g. a device with ports) or a direct restatement confirming what is actually being sold.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case furniture-only listing; electronic-sounding claims disregarded as unverifiable.

risks.risk: Unseen wood surface damage (scratches, water marks, chips) on sides not visible.
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides and top surface in good light.

risks.risk: Interior cupboard condition and joint/structural integrity unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of open cupboards and a close-up of joints/hinges.

risks.risk: TV shown may not be included in the sale, affecting perceived value.
risks.proof: Seller's explicit written confirmation plus a photo with price tag or listing text showing TV included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as TV stand/console only, without TV.

risks.risk: Claimed 'center table' not shown or verified to exist.
risks.proof: A photo of the center table alongside the console.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as TV console only; center table excluded from valuation.

proof_requests: Photos of all sides and top surface of the TV stand in good lighting.
Photo of the open cupboard interiors.
Close-up of joints, hinges, and back panel for structural assessment.
A photo of the center table mentioned in the listing.
Clear photo of the UK receipt and the 'original pads' referenced.
Confirmation and photo showing whether the TV is included in the sale.
response.reason: The seller's claims about overheating, ports, and pads describe an electronic device, not the wooden TV stand the witness actually observed, suggesting a mismatched or copy-pasted description that raises fraud concern.
